description: Work in the chatting user's own Chrome through the WebAgent browser extension only (no server or headless browser): open allowed sites, read pages, click, type and press keys while the user watches and can take over.

settings.label: Sites the agent may control
settings.hint: Hosts separated by commas or new lines, for example crm.example.com. Each covers its subdomains. The agent cannot open or act on any other site.

skill_summary: Operate the chatting user's own browser on the agent's allowed sites; check browser_backend first.
